children: Decoy Therapeutics entered into a warrant inducement agreement to secure immediate cash exercises and boost liquidity. An existing holder exercised 1,184,434 Series B warrants after the exercise price was cut to $3.25, generating approximately $3.85 million in gross proceeds. In consideration, Decoy issued 2,368,868 new unregistered warrants at $3.25, exercisable immediately and expiring in five years, while also reducing the exercise price on its Series A and C milestone warrants. Proceeds will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes.
: Warrant inducement letter and private placement of new warrants
